subject: npmx_interrupt_handler_510fe2 crash root-caused and fixed (no fault masked)
root_cause: harness npmx_runstock.json defsym'd npmx_core_interrupt AND npmx_core_proc both to 0x511002 (an unrelated g2-npmx-main-driver function). The C body's byte==0 core path then called garbage -> hard fault (0xeffffffe).
fix: corrected defsyms to stock addresses npmx_core_interrupt=0x55eda4, npmx_core_proc=0x55edac (proven by BL targets at 0x510ff6/0x510ffc in npmx_interrupt_handler @0x510fe2).

disasm_evidence.npmx_core_proc_0x55edac: ldrb [r0,#0xcc]; cmp #0; beq ret; movs #0; strb [r0,#0xcc]; bl 0x55eaae; ...
